A Cantor expansion is a sum of the form a_n n!+a_{n-1} (n-1)!+\dots a_2 2!+a_1 1! where $0 \leq a_i \leq i$ are integers for $i=1,2,\dots n$. For example, the Cantor expansion of 17 is $17=2(3!)+2(2!)+1(1!).$ Note that $17=1(3!)+5(2!)+1(1!)$ is correct but is not a valid Cantor expansion of 17 since we insist the coefficient of n! is no more than n.
